messages:
maria: Quick draft of the internal postcard for tomorrow's push. Can folks skim? I tried to keep it one paragraph + 3 bullets. Need sign-off + explicit rollback matrix.

maria: Draft:
'Tomorrow at 15:00 UTC we'll roll v2.4.1 with latency fixes and batching improvements. Canary (5% traffic) for 30m, then ramp to 50% for 30m before full rollout. No DB schema changes. Owners: infra, runtime, metrics.'

sanjay: LGTM on copy. Re: rollback matrix — we should pin model binary to `v2.4.0` as fallback and include a capacity fallback to dedicated pool B if latency spike > 30%.

jen: small wording nit: change "Owners: infra, runtime, metrics" -> "Owners: @sanjay (runtime), @ryan (infra), @jen (metrics)" so people know who to ping.

ryan: +1. Also adding deploybot cues: canary at 15:00 UTC, can we do a short maintenance window note? e.g., "Expect 1-2 min rolling restarts per pod; no client-facing downtime." keeps expectations clear.

maria: good call — I'll add maintenance note. Sanjay — model pin fallback to `v2.4.0` ok? Does that require any DB/kv migration rollback steps? 

sanjay: No migrations. Just swap model artifact and restart runtime. Add step: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime --namespace=prod` and monitor `runtime-requests` SLOs for 10m. If errors >5%, trigger full rollback.

maria: added those steps. Draft now includes short command snippet. Pls check phrasing:

```
Rollback quick steps:
1) set model tag -> `v2.4.0` in infra config
2) `kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime --namespace=prod`
3) monitor SLOs (latency, errors) for 10m
4) if errors >5% or latency +30% -> call rollback and open incident channel
```

jen: can we define "errors >5%" precisely? Is that 5% 5xx or request failures? I'd say combined 5xx+5xx-like client errors. I'll add a tiny metric definition: `errors = 5xx_responses + grpc_stream_failures`.

ryan: Deploy-bot: I'll schedule the canary window in the deploy queue. One ask: can we do the 5% canary on region-west first then region-east? That reduces blast radius and helps infra debug.

maria: yes please region-west first. Add a line to the postcard: "Canary: region-west (5%) -> region-east (5%) -> global ramp." Done.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: Canary v2.4.1 -> region-west 2026-03-21T15:00:00Z (30m). Next step: region-east ramp if green.

sanjay: tiny addition to release notes bullets: "performance: ~8-12% P95 latency improvement on long-context workloads" — we should be careful with exact numbers, maybe say "~10% P95 improvement".

maria: ok changed to "~10% P95 improvement (long-context workloads)". Any objections to me posting the postcard in #general at 14:30 UTC for the broader heads-up? I want ~30m cushion before push.

jen: 14:30 post is fine. Add a link to the internal playbook in the post: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/release-v2-4-1

ryan: I'll be on standby during canary. tagging @oncall infra. Also I'll add a deploybot pin step: create canary marker and attach logs to the thread: `deploy-bot: attach canary-log`.

maria: final check: release notes bullets are 3 lines (perf, batching cache, bugfix for token overflow). Anyone want to expand the bugfix detail? Otherwise I'll send.

sanjay: leave bugfix short. If support wants more we can link to the PR.

jen: okay. Send it. I'll watch metrics.

maria: Posting in 5. Thanks all :tada:

deploy-bot: Announcement queued for 2026-03-21T14:30:00Z to #general and pinned to #eng-releases. Canary job created: job-8432. Logs will stream to the thread.

maria: (posting now)
